text: Claude writes about ninety percent of Claude Code's own code.
Since June, merged pull requests have more than doubled. Reverts fell by forty percent.
Thirty thousand changes a day. Nobody reads that much code.
So the team stopped treating review as one gate at the end,
The change sets its own risk tier.
And the push waits for green.
Now it's a mod. Type slash land.
It runs on haiku, sends the diff once, and reports what it spent.
Low risk lands with no one in the loop.
You prompted it. You're the reviewer.
Less human time per change. No more reverts than before.
